capabilities: Open .docx files in a read-only view
Show text, headings, tables, comments, and notes
Filter document text, comments, notes, and media metadata
Warn about risky or malformed package content
disambiguation: Not a pixel-perfect Word renderer; it shows read-only text, structure, and package diagnostics rather than a visual replica.
extras: Strictly read-only with no editing, conversion, annotation, or Markdown export; treats documents as untrusted packages and makes no network, clipboard, shell, or write-back calls. Early v0.1.1 release installed manually from GitHub release assets; no .doc, .docm, or macro-enabled support yet.
problem: Obsidian cannot open .docx files, so users need a way to inspect Word documents without converting them or leaving the app.

relations.evidence: No launching Microsoft Word, LibreOffice, Pages, or another external viewer.

summary: Read-only viewer that opens .docx files inside Obsidian to inspect text, structure, media, and package diagnostics without conversion.
